item.tib: bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs la mchod pa'i bkod byang nor bu mdzes pa'i dpal be'u rnam par bkra ba'i rgyan mchog
item.coloph: de ltar rgyal ba'i tshogs la mchod pa byed pa'i tshig rgyan shin tu spro bar byas te/ bkod byang brgya dang rtsa dgu 'di gzhung lugs phal po che la shes rab kyi snang ba yongs su rgyas shing / mdo 'bul ('bum) gzugs (gzungs) dang gzhung rnams kyi dbu mchod dang mdo sde du ma'i mngon par rtogs pa khong du chud cing / gsang sngags kyi gzhung rnams lugs phal po che dang bdud rtsi sman gyi byung khungs sogs dang / mdor na gsung rab gi mtha' yas pa la shes rab kyi blo gros rab tu rgyas shing mang du thos pa gshen rgyal rin po che rnams kyi spyi bor len po dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis/ me khyi lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin/ gnyan sa ri khrod gdong khrod kyi gnas su dben par gnas pa'i tshe/ shes rab yongs su rgyas pa'i rtsol bas legs par brtsams te grub par bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//
